description: a(n) is the number of red balls in an urn such that if the urn contains b(n)=A101265(n) blue balls, the probability of drawing 3 red balls without replacement is the same as drawing 1 red and 2 blue balls without replacement; that is, binomial(a(n),3) = binomial(a(n),1) * binomial(b(n),2).
